verdict.rationale: Penpot documents personal access tokens as an alternative login method that lets an app call its API. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be limited by permission, file, team, or read/write scope, so they are an adjacent credential feature, not the scoped, least-privilege credentials the story asks for. No evidence describes scoping for agent or MCP connections either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
